cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've chosen orange for our cafe. You may ask how it improves the room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I see a sample before we decide?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A sensible request. I authorize you to judge it at full scale.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've painted the whole room? I said I wanted yellow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll permit you to describe it as "sunset yellow." Can I take that as your approval of the walls I've painted?
